description: This source file defines the BackupWorker class, which performs backup operations in the app using Android's WorkManager framework. It manages creating backups asynchronously and handles success or failure notifications.

classes.name: BackupWorker
classes.description: A worker class that performs backup operations asynchronously using coroutines and Android's WorkManager.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the doWork method of CoroutineWorker to perform backup operation asynchronously, handle success and failure notifications, and return the result.
